title: PR #109: governance: add machine-readable PR registry and merge order
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Purpose
Adds an organization-wide machine-readable PR queue and merge-order policy.

## Included
- `docs/governance/ATC-PR-REGISTRY-001.json`: 148 unique PRs from four date-partitioned open-PR searches, ranked by initial risk/dependency triage.
- `docs/governance/ATC-PR-REGISTRY-001-POLICY.md`: priority tiers, dependency/duplicate handling, exact-SHA evidence requirements, and merge gates.

## Safety
- No PRs were merged or closed.
- No tags/releases were created.
- No required checks or branch protections were weakened.
- Exact head SHAs, live checks and review approvals are deliberately not inferred from search metadata.
- Registry completeness remains provisional until reconciled with live GitHub inventory.
- Explicitly known dependencies and likely overlapping PR groups are marked for review.

The registry ranks work; it does not authorize merges.
